limits: Diagnostic timing includes instrumentation and scheduling effects.
Recovered figures combine the suite with targeted replacements and are not a second full-suite duration.
Public wrappers omit native internal transaction-control statements.
Connection lifetime starts at constructor when wrapped, otherwise first public operation.
Statement delay measures prepare to last execution, not GC/finalization.
Named Store validation API scopes and transaction callbacks are counted; internal free-function validation ownership uses stack attribution, not a separately instrumented invocation boundary.
SQL text, filenames of databases and bind values are not recorded.
Native pragma/backup/serialize internals are not covered; multi-statement exec counts one public API execution.
